description: Generator Evaluation page — a development tool for assessing workflow generation quality through aggregate dashboard metrics, pipeline inspection, step quality evaluation, and edit analysis. (Benchmarks, Example Library, Insights, and Training Data tabs were removed as vestigial — see plans/generator-eval-design.md.)

groups.name: Evaluation Tool Navigation
groups.description: The Generator Evaluation page is a multi-tabbed development tool that provides four perspectives on workflow generation quality. Users navigate between the Dashboard (aggregate metrics), Pipeline Inspector (step-by-step generation analysis), Step Quality (per-step evaluation against coverage criteria), and Edit Analysis (gap between generated and human-edited workflows). The page is clearly marked as a dev-only tool since it is intended for workflow generator development rather than end-user operation.

assertions.description: Users can identify the Generator Evaluation page with a clear heading and a dev badge indicating this is a development-only tool for assessing workflow generation quality
Users can access the Dashboard tab to view aggregate generation quality metrics and overall performance summaries across all evaluated workflows
Users can access the Pipeline Inspector tab to trace the workflow generation process step by step, understanding how inputs are transformed into the final generated workflow
Users can access the Edit Analysis tab to study the differences between AI-generated workflows and their human-edited versions, identifying systematic gaps in generation quality

groups.name: Generation Quality Assessment
groups.description: The core purpose of this tool is enabling developers to assess how accurately and completely the workflow generator produces workflows. The Edit Analysis tab reveals the gap between what the generator produces and what humans ultimately deploy by comparing generated vs edited workflow versions. The Step Quality tab evaluates individual steps against semantic coverage criteria. Together these answer: how much human intervention is needed after generation, and where does the generator fall short?

assertions.description: Users can access the Step Quality tab to evaluate individual workflow steps against semantic coverage criteria and identify quality gate failures

groups.name: Dev Tool Indicator
groups.description: The page is marked as a development-only tool to prevent confusion with production workflow management surfaces.

assertions.description: The page is clearly marked as a development-only tool so users understand it is intended for generator improvement rather than production workflow management

Users can inspect the generation pipeline in detail, tracing how raw inputs are processed through each generation stage to produce the final workflow, enabling diagnosis of specific pipeline steps that introduce errors

target.label: Pipeline Inspector tab for step-by-step tracing

groups.name: Pipeline Agent Schema Compliance
groups.description: The Pipeline Inspector's agent trace table includes schema compliance visibility for each agent in a pipeline execution. Each trace row shows whether the agent's output passed JSON schema validation on the first attempt, required coercion or retries, or failed entirely. When expanded, traces with validation failures display the specific validation error summary. This helps developers identify which agents or models consistently produce malformed output, informing model selection and prompt tuning decisions.

assertions.description: The agent trace table includes a Schema column header so users can see at a glance which agents produced schema-valid output

target.label: Schema column header in agent trace table

assertions.description: When a trace row with validation errors is expanded, users can see the specific validation error summary to understand what schema violations occurred, enabling targeted prompt or output format fixes
assertions.condition: An agent trace with validation errors is expanded

target.label: Validation error summary in expanded trace row

states.name: Dashboard — Aggregate Metrics
states.description: The Dashboard tab is active, showing aggregate generation quality metrics including Total Generations, Success Rate, and Avg Duration cards, plus a trend chart. This is the default tab when the page loads.

states.name: Pipeline Inspector — Step-by-Step Analysis
states.description: The Pipeline Inspector tab is active, showing a left panel with a list of generation artifacts and a right panel with pipeline stage details (Discovery, Builder, Auto-fix, Verification, Hardener) for the selected artifact. Before selection, prompts the user to select a generation.

states.name: Step Quality — Per-Step Evaluation
states.description: The Step Quality tab is active, showing a textarea for pasting workflow JSON (auto-loads from the most recent artifact) and an Evaluate button. After evaluation, displays an Overall Score, Quality Gate result, Steps Evaluated count, Coverage percentage, and a step-level heatmap with dimension scores.

states.name: Edit Analysis — Generated vs Edited Comparison
states.description: The Edit Analysis tab is active, showing charts and statistics about the gap between AI-generated workflows and their human-edited versions, including a Most Edited Fields bar chart and edit distance distribution.
